why: 1.0.6: two reported alerts, the world-map 'Fishing: 1' line and the '(Dungeon)' tags of the quest list (owner screenshots), version bump

ops.old: L.ALERTS[#L.ALERTS + 1] = { "There is no loot.", fa("غنیمتی وجود ندارد.") }

ops.new:
-- 1.0.6 (the owner: "Fishing: 1" under the map title and "(Dungeon)" in the quest
        -- list stayed English): fixed label lines (L.MAP_LINES); the second value tells the
        -- caller it is a label, so no English line is added under it
        local LL = L.MAP_LINES
        if type(LL) == "table" then
            for _, row in ipairs(LL) do
                local okg, s, n = pcall(string.gsub, plain, row[1], row[2])
                if okg and n and n > 0 and s ~= plain then
                    return s, true
                end
            end
        end
        local base, lv = string.match(plain, "^(.-)%s*(%(%s*%d+[%s%-%d]*%))$")

ops.old: local function apply_inplace(fs, faText, enText, kind)
ops.new: local function apply_inplace(fs, faText, enText, kind, noEn)

ops.old: if kind == "map" and map_mode() == 2 and type(enText) == "string" and enText ~= "" then
ops.new: if kind == "map" and not noEn and map_mode() == 2 and type(enText) == "string" and enText ~= "" then

ops.old:
local faText = enText ~= "" and fa(enText, kind == "maplabel") or nil
    if faText then
        apply_inplace(fs, faText, enText, kind)
ops.new:
local faText, lbl
    if enText ~= "" then
        faText, lbl = fa(enText, kind == "maplabel")
    end
    if faText then
        apply_inplace(fs, faText, enText, kind, lbl)
